newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sugar panel sets monthly production refunds.
newsitem.headline: Sugar panel sets monthly production refunds.

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee on Wednesday set monthly production refunds, an EU official said.
"The Committee also set quarterly refunds for chemical products made with sugar and refunds for non-annex II products," the official said.
The refunds for chemical products were set at 34.565 ecus per 100 kg and non-annex two refunds were set at 41.67 ecus per 100 kg for whites and 38.33 ecus per 100 kg for raws.
The committee also maintained import duties on cane molasses at an unchanged 0.04 ecus per 100 kg.
"The tariff was based on a representative price of 8.17 ecus per 100 kg which is the same as the previous week's figure," the official said.
Duty on beet molasses remains at zero with a representative price of 11.22 ecus per 100 kg compared with the previous week's figure of 11.23 ecus per 100kg.
